eras.label: Prehistory
eras.description: Context for the modern LLM stack: embeddings, sequence-to-sequence learning and attention before Transformers.

eras.label: Transformer era
eras.description: The Transformer replaces recurrence with attention and becomes the architecture modern LLMs build on.

eras.label: Pretrained language model era
eras.description: Pretraining on large text corpora becomes the default starting point for language understanding and generation.

eras.label: Scaling era
eras.description: Larger models, larger datasets and few-shot prompting turn scale itself into a usable capability.

eras.label: Instruction and chatbot era
eras.description: Instruction tuning and human feedback make general models easier to direct, while chat puts them in front of everyday users.

eras.label: LLM explosion
eras.description: Frontier APIs, strong open-weight families and multimodal systems all arrive at once.

eras.label: Multimodal and open-model race
eras.description: Vision, longer context, stronger open models and dedicated reasoning systems move into the mainstream.

eras.label: Reasoning and agentic era
eras.description: Models increasingly reason, use tools, operate software and run longer tasks while open models keep closing capability gaps.

milestones.title: word2vec
milestones.description: Efficient word embeddings trained on large corpora. Similar words end up near each other in vector space, making semantics computable at scale.
milestones.whyItMatters: Established that cheap self-supervised representation learning works, the premise behind everything that followed.
milestones.sourceLabel: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space (Mikolov et al., 2013)

milestones.title: Neural attention
milestones.description: Let a decoder weigh encoder states instead of squeezing the whole input into one fixed vector.
milestones.whyItMatters: Attention fixed the seq2seq bottleneck and became the core mechanism of later LLMs.
milestones.sourceLabel: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate (Bahdanau et al., 2014)

milestones.title: Sequence-to-sequence learning
milestones.description: An encoder-decoder LSTM pair that maps one sequence to another, applied to machine translation.
milestones.whyItMatters: The encoder-decoder shape became the template for translation, summarization and eventually generation.
milestones.sourceLabel: Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks (Sutskever et al., 2014)

milestones.title: Attention Is All You Need
milestones.description: Replaced recurrence with self-attention throughout, training faster and scaling cleanly.
milestones.whyItMatters: The architecture almost every subsequent LLM is built from.
milestones.sourceLabel: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani et al., 2017)

milestones.title: ELMo
milestones.description: Contextual word representations from a deep bidirectional LSTM, replacing one static vector per word.
milestones.whyItMatters: A step from static embeddings toward contextual representations, shortly before BERT.
milestones.sourceLabel: Deep contextualized word representations (Peters et al., 2018)

milestones.title: GPT-1
milestones.description: Generative pretraining of a transformer decoder on raw text, then fine-tuning for specific tasks.
milestones.whyItMatters: Showed unsupervised pretraining transfers to downstream tasks, the recipe still in use.
milestones.sourceLabel: Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training (Radford et al., 2018)

milestones.title: BERT
milestones.description: Bidirectional encoder pretraining with masked tokens, then fine-tuning.
milestones.whyItMatters: Dominated NLP benchmarks and made pretrain-then-fine-tune the default; encoder models went a different direction from decoder LLMs.
milestones.sourceLabel: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers (Devlin et al., 2018)

milestones.title: GPT-2
milestones.description: A 1.5B-parameter language model, initially released in stages over misuse concerns.
milestones.whyItMatters: First model whose fluent long-form output made misuse policy a mainstream discussion.
milestones.sourceLabel: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners (Radford et al., 2019)

milestones.title: GPT-3
milestones.description: 175B parameters trained on a large web corpus.
milestones.whyItMatters: Few-shot prompting on a scaled model worked well enough to become an interface, not just a research result.
milestones.sourceLabel: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (Brown et al., 2020)

milestones.title: RLHF applied to summarization
milestones.description: Fine-tuned models against human preference comparisons using reinforcement learning.
milestones.whyItMatters: The alignment technique later used to make instruction-following chat assistants.
milestones.sourceLabel: Learning to summarize from human feedback (Stiennon et al., 2020)

milestones.title: GitHub Copilot preview
milestones.description: A code-completion product built on OpenAI Codex, offered directly inside the editor.
milestones.whyItMatters: First widely used LLM product outside chat; made code generation a daily tool.

milestones.title: InstructGPT
milestones.description: A 1.3B instruction-tuned model was preferred over raw GPT-3 for following user instructions.
milestones.whyItMatters: Showed alignment tuning matters more than raw scale for usefulness; the direct ancestor of chat assistants.
milestones.sourceLabel: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback (Ouyang et al., 2022)

milestones.title: Chinchilla scaling laws
milestones.description: Showed most models of the time were undertrained, and that tokens matter as much as parameters per unit of compute.
milestones.whyItMatters: Changed how labs sized models and training runs for the next generation.
milestones.sourceLabel: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models (Hoffmann et al., 2022)

milestones.title: PaLM
milestones.description: A 540B-parameter dense decoder trained efficiently on TPUs, with strong reasoning and multilingual results.
milestones.whyItMatters: Demonstrated that scale plus chain-of-thought prompting could handle multi-step reasoning.
milestones.sourceLabel: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways (Chowdhery et al., 2022)

milestones.title: ChatGPT
milestones.description: A conversational interface over an instruction-tuned GPT-3.5 model, released as a low-key research preview.
milestones.whyItMatters: Put conversational LLMs in front of a mass public audience and made chat the default interface for the current LLM wave.
milestones.sourceLabel: ChatGPT: Optimizing Language Models for Dialogue (OpenAI, 2022)

milestones.title: LLaMA
milestones.description: Research-licensed weights released to approved researchers; a 7B model rivaled much larger models.
milestones.whyItMatters: Its smaller research models became widely used as bases for community fine-tuning and accelerated open-weight experimentation.
milestones.sourceLabel: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models (Touvron et al., 2023)

milestones.title: Claude
milestones.description: Anthropic's first public assistant, launched in open beta.
milestones.whyItMatters: Turned constitutional AI from a research agenda into a competitive product line.

milestones.title: GPT-4
milestones.description: Frontier model with image input, announced with professional-exam results.
milestones.whyItMatters: Set the frontier bar for the following year and normalized image input.

milestones.title: Llama 2
milestones.description: Weights under a commercial-use license, with chat-tuned variants included.
milestones.whyItMatters: First major open-weight family cleared for commercial use; expanded the open ecosystem considerably.
milestones.sourceLabel: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models (Touvron et al., 2023)

milestones.title: Mistral 7B
milestones.description: 7B Apache-2.0 weights performing at the level of Llama 2 13B.
milestones.whyItMatters: Proved small permissively licensed models could be competitive and kicked off the efficient open-model segment.

milestones.title: Gemini 1
milestones.description: Natively multimodal family spanning Ultra, Pro and Nano sizes.
milestones.whyItMatters: Google's first frontier family after the PaLM line, multimodal from the start.
milestones.sourceLabel: Gemini: Google's most capable AI model (Google, 2023)

milestones.title: Mixtral 8x7B
milestones.description: A sparse mixture-of-experts model with 47B total parameters, 13B active, under Apache 2.0.
milestones.whyItMatters: Brought MoE to the open ecosystem, matching or beating larger dense models at lower inference cost.

milestones.title: Claude 3 family
milestones.description: Haiku, Sonnet and Opus capability tiers in one family, with vision input.
milestones.whyItMatters: Standardized the tiered family structure and pricing model other labs adopted.

milestones.title: Llama 3
milestones.description: 8B and 70B models trained on a much larger tokenizer and dataset, with a commercial license.
milestones.whyItMatters: Reset expectations for open-weight quality at common sizes.

milestones.title: GPT-4o
milestones.description: Natively multimodal model handling text, audio and vision in one network.
milestones.whyItMatters: Real-time voice and vision in a single API model instead of a pipeline of specialists.

milestones.title: Qwen2
milestones.description: Second-generation Qwen family with strong multilingual results up to 72B, several sizes under Apache 2.0.
milestones.whyItMatters: Made Qwen a default base for multilingual open fine-tunes.

milestones.title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
milestones.description: Mid-sized model released at twice the speed of Claude 3 Opus with frontier-level results.
milestones.whyItMatters: Showed a mid-tier model could lead benchmarks, pressuring the size-based pricing ladder.

milestones.title: OpenAI o1
milestones.description: A reasoning-focused model trained to spend more computation on difficult problems before answering.
milestones.whyItMatters: Made inference-time reasoning a first-class product capability and pushed the industry toward explicit reasoning modes.

milestones.title: DeepSeek-V3
milestones.description: 671B total / 37B active parameter MoE with released weights, notable for training efficiency.
milestones.whyItMatters: Showed how a large MoE design could pair strong capability with much lower active-parameter compute than its total parameter count suggests.

milestones.title: DeepSeek-R1
milestones.description: Open-weight reasoning model with a published RL training recipe and distilled variants.
milestones.whyItMatters: Brought strong reasoning behavior and a published training recipe into the open-weight ecosystem.

milestones.title: Command A
milestones.description: Cohere released a 111B enterprise model focused on tool use, retrieval, multilingual work and efficient private deployment.
milestones.whyItMatters: Brought agentic enterprise workloads and large-context private deployment into a single production-focused model line.

milestones.title: Gemini 2.5
milestones.description: Google introduced Gemini 2.5 as a thinking-model family, starting with Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental.
milestones.whyItMatters: Reasoning became part of the default Gemini model design rather than a separate research mode.
milestones.sourceLabel: Gemini 2.5: Our most intelligent AI model (Google, 2025)

milestones.title: Llama 4
milestones.description: Meta introduced the first Llama 4 models, Scout and Maverick, as natively multimodal mixture-of-experts systems.
milestones.whyItMatters: Moved the Llama family into native multimodality and MoE while keeping downloadable weights central to the release.

milestones.title: Qwen3
milestones.description: Qwen3 combined thinking and non-thinking modes across dense and MoE models, with major releases published as open weights.
milestones.whyItMatters: Made hybrid reasoning and efficient MoE designs broadly available across a large open-weight model family.

milestones.title: Claude 4
milestones.description: Anthropic introduced Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4 with stronger coding, extended reasoning and tool use.
milestones.whyItMatters: Pushed long-running coding and agent workflows into the core Claude product line.

milestones.title: Magistral
milestones.description: Mistral released its first reasoning-model family in open and enterprise variants.
milestones.whyItMatters: Added a multilingual reasoning line to the European open-model ecosystem instead of leaving reasoning to closed frontier APIs.

milestones.title: GPT-5
milestones.description: OpenAI introduced GPT-5 as a unified system that routes between fast responses and deeper reasoning.
milestones.whyItMatters: Collapsed the split between a general model and a separate reasoning model into one routed product experience.

milestones.title: DeepSeek-V3.1
milestones.description: DeepSeek-V3.1 added hybrid thinking and non-thinking modes with stronger tool use and multi-step agent behavior.
milestones.whyItMatters: Showed the open-weight DeepSeek line shifting from pure reasoning toward a combined reasoning-and-agent model.

milestones.title: Mistral 3
milestones.description: Mistral 3 paired small dense models with Mistral Large 3, a large sparse MoE family released under Apache 2.0.
milestones.whyItMatters: Kept permissive licensing viable at both small local sizes and large frontier-oriented scales.

milestones.title: Muse Spark
milestones.description: Meta introduced Muse Spark as a natively multimodal reasoning model with tool use and multi-agent orchestration.
milestones.whyItMatters: Marked Meta's shift from the Llama-era model line toward a new family built around multimodal reasoning and agents.

milestones.title: GPT-5.5
milestones.description: OpenAI released GPT-5.5 with a stronger focus on coding, computer use, research and multi-step knowledge work.
milestones.whyItMatters: Made computer use and longer autonomous work a mainstream frontier-model capability rather than a separate agent demo.

milestones.title: DeepSeek-V4 Preview
milestones.description: DeepSeek previewed its V4 family with one-million-token context and open weights for Pro and Flash variants.
milestones.whyItMatters: Made million-token context a headline feature of a major open-weight model family rather than a closed-API-only capability.

milestones.title: Gemini 3.5 and Gemini Omni
milestones.description: Google announced Gemini 3.5 alongside Gemini Omni, expanding its frontier line around action and broad multimodal generation.
milestones.whyItMatters: Put agentic action and richer multimodality at the center of Google's next model generation.

milestones.title: Command A+
milestones.description: Cohere released Command A+, an Apache-2.0 MoE model aimed at sovereign and private enterprise deployment.
milestones.whyItMatters: Brought a permissively licensed, enterprise-focused reasoning model into a market dominated by hosted proprietary systems.

milestones.title: Claude Sonnet 5
milestones.description: Anthropic released Sonnet 5 with stronger planning, tool use, coding and autonomous task execution.
milestones.whyItMatters: Moved more agentic capability into Anthropic's mainstream Sonnet tier instead of reserving it for the largest models.

milestones.title: GPT-6 Astra
milestones.description: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Astra with a strong emphasis on computer use, browsing, coding and long multi-step professional work.
milestones.whyItMatters: Made full computer-operation workflows part of the flagship model story rather than an add-on around text generation.
milestones.sourceLabel: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence (OpenAI, 2026)

milestones.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
milestones.description: DeepSeek released V4.1-Flash with native visual input and an asymmetric MoE design using different active-parameter budgets for input and output.
milestones.whyItMatters: Combined multimodality, agent-oriented capability and aggressive serving efficiency in the newest DeepSeek architecture family.
